spec.scene: Maya has an appointment and asks to move tomorrow’s group meal an hour later. Others agree. The place stays the same.
facts: Tomorrow's group pizza moves from noon to 1 pm. The venue is unchanged.

dialogue: Maya: ugh finally on my couch
Leo: long thursday?
Me: mine was so slow
Maya: my laptop died again at like 4:30
Leo: did you do the ritual
Me: turn it off and on again?
Maya: twice lol
Leo: IT is never getting back to you guys
Me: nope still waiting since last week
Maya: same, mine was dragging all afternoon
Leo: did you guys get cold today again
Me: yes wore the heavy jacket again
Maya: me too, freezing this morning
Leo: fall jacket season is here for real
Me: what did you have for dinner
Leo: leftover pasta again lol i'm in a loop
Maya: soup and toast over here again
Me: cozy grandma meal
Maya: exactly, plus that weird lemon tea
Leo: save me a virtual one
Me: me too, chamomile me up
Maya: okay one weird one for leo, lemon thing for you
Leo: you remembered!!
Me: did you go to gym today?
Maya: yeah this morning, arms today not legs thank god
Leo: no leg day death today?
Maya: no lol i can actually walk
Me: did you go yesterday too or just today?
Maya: just today, skipped yesterday
Leo: relatable
Me: i still need to do dishes ugh
Maya: the never ending dishes
Leo: speaking of background noise did you rewatch that sketch
Me: the crying suit guy? yeah while i cooked pasta
Maya: never go back to workkkk
Leo: you do the voice perfectly in text somehow
Me: it's stuck in my head at work now
Maya: same i thought it in a meeting today
Leo: never go back to meetings
Maya: EXACTLY
Me: are you still doing laundry hell?
Leo: don't even ask, basket is still full from friday
Maya: the ecosystem grows
Leo: rude but accurate
Me: did you play that cooking game last night?
Leo: yeah for like an hour, randoms burned everything again
Maya: sounds like me tbh
Me: you only started two fires last time
Maya: thank you!! see leo
Leo: revisionist history, it was three
Maya: whateverrr
Leo: we still on for tomorrow night maybe?
Me: i might join for one round after pizza fuel
Maya: depends how sore i am but maybe
Leo: no pressure, no kitchen fires promised
Maya: no promises from my side
Me: lol
Maya: okay sooo bad news about tomorrow
Leo: oh no what
Maya: that thing i had at 1:30 got moved to noon
Me: oh the appointment?
Maya: yeah they pushed it right into lunch
Maya: can we do pizza at 1 instead of noon tomorrow?
Leo: yeah 1 works for me
Me: yeah that works, 1 is good for me too
Maya: thank youuu i felt so bad asking late
Leo: nah you're good, i'll just circle for parking a little later lol
Me: same mario's spot just an hour later right?
Maya: yes same place, just 1
Leo: perfect, still mario's on pine?
Me: yep, they do slices fast anyway
Maya: yeah i should still be fine after, my thing should be done by like 12:45
Leo: we can just meet out front at 1?
Maya: yes meet out front at 1 works
Me: bet, i can walk over, it's like 10 mins
Leo: i'll bus or drive, we'll see
Maya: garlic knots i'm coming for you
Me: lol you and those knots
Leo: in honor of the crying suit guy
Maya: never go back to work
Me: put it on a t-shirt already
Leo: honestly it would sell
cost_note: API did not report a charge
